notes: Portable C++ and Java parity for the mapped native 36-assertion HLA_EVOKED pending ordinary time-advance restore case. One time-constrained member requests an untimed save, requests TAR(5), and completes the save from Initiate Federate Save before its first grant. After a post-save TAR(9), restoring the saved image returns to initial time and rejects TAR(6) while the saved TAR is reconstructed. Federation Restored precedes the fresh grant at 5. The adapter supplies provider, endpoint, logical-time implementation, callback model, and a standard IEEE 1516.2-2025 FOM with nonRegulatedGrant enabled. Fifteen direct requirement-section pairs cover clauses 4.19, 4.20, 4.23, 4.27, 4.29, 4.30, 4.32, 8.5.5, 8.6.3, 8.8.3, and 8.18.1. The native case passed 36 assertions against the installed package; portable C++ primary/contract passed under integer64 and float64 time. Java compiles against the official API-only JAR but provider runtime remains unverified. This is bounded public-API evidence, not a queued/in-transit TSO, multi-member, durable restore, interoperability, or conformance claim.
